## Personal website and portfolio

**The problem.** I needed somewhere to put coursework and projects that was not a
folder on my laptop, and that a recruiter could open in one click.

**What I did.** Built this site as a [Quarto](https://quarto.org) project, published
it with GitHub Pages from the `docs/` folder, and set it up so a new post is a new
folder and a `quarto render` away.

**Outcome.** A site I can extend every week for the rest of MDS without touching the
plumbing again.

[Source on GitHub](https://github.com/EvanPai/EvanPai.github.io)
